message: The other day, I found myself watching the weather channel as they dramatically declared a storm was on its way. I thought, "Well, I should probably check my emergency supplies..." Turns out, my idea of being prepared was a half-eaten granola bar and an old flashlight that only works when it feels like it. 😅 If you're like me and sometimes forget the basics, there’s a handy resource that can help you get ready without all the chaos. What’s the most ridiculous thing you’ve discovered in your emergency stash?
